title: Hello Monday with Jessi Hempel — 'so many ways for people to make money without creating any value at all'
summary: Jessi Hempel, Senior Editor at Large at LinkedIn and host of Hello Monday, releases her interview with Eric on Incorruptible. The episode covers shareholder primacy's 1980s origins, 'financial gravity,' AI-driven layoffs, and structural integrity as a defense against extraction.
blockquote: We've built an economy now that's created so many ways for people to make money without creating any value at all. In fact, often by destroying value.
blockquote_source: Eric Ries on Hello Monday with Jessi Hempel
attribution_title: Host, Hello Monday with Jessi Hempel; Senior Editor at Large at LinkedIn
